title: A2 Core reading lab
subtitle: Create a full structural reading note for one paragraph.
overview: This capstone lab asks you to produce a compact reading note: text divisions, verb skeleton, dependent forms, key lexical decisions, and a provisional translation.
Your note should distinguish what is explicit in the Greek from interpretive inferences you may later test with wider context and trusted tools.

items.grc: ἐὰν τὰς ἐντολάς μου τηρήσητε, μενεῖτε ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ μου.
items.en: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love.

items.grc: καθὼς ἐγὼ τὰς ἐντολὰς τοῦ πατρός μου τετήρηκα καὶ μένω αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ.
items.en: Just as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.
